title: Basic Income Tax Concepts in India
source: Income Tax Department, Government of India
content: Gross Total Income (GTI) is the total income earned from all five heads of income: Salary, House Property, Profits and Gains of Business or Profession, Capital Gains, and Income from Other Sources (such as bank interest and dividends). Net Taxable Income is calculated by subtracting eligible deductions (Chapter VI-A) and exemptions from Gross Total Income. Financial Year (FY) is the 12-month period from April 1 to March 31 in which income is earned. Assessment Year (AY) is the immediately following financial year in which the income earned during the FY is assessed and taxed. For example, income earned in Tax Year 2026-27 is assessed in the corresponding assessment period under current tax rules.
